comment: Sevii quest chain, beat 2: the Ruby pickup, Mt. Ember Ruby Path B5F (pokefirered MtEmber_RubyPath_B5F_EventScript_Ruby - defined, oddly, in MtEmber_RubyPath_B3F/scripts.inc in the source tree): setflag FLAG_GOT_RUBY + giveitem ITEM_RUBY. The Ruby object stands at (7,7) in the source map. There is no dialogue: the source's obtain message (MtEmber_RubyPath_B3F_Text_FoundARuby) is a fanfare obtain-message, not a say line, and it is not in the restored Sevii bank (the Ruby Path interiors have no bank group) - the give_item step IS the pickup. PUW flag sevii_ruby_held mirrors FLAG_GOT_RUBY (Celio's delivery branch checks it, exactly as the source script checks the flag). PATCHED by code_prep_sevii_access: the FoundARuby receipt line now plays after the give -- MtEmber_RubyPath_B3F_Text_FoundARuby is decoded in that prep's sevii_bank_additions.json (group MtEmber_RubyPath_B3F, the text file the source keeps the Ruby Path labels in). The say's dialogue map is the B3F group because that is where the label lives; the pickup itself is unchanged.
